info.name: Get Receipts based on filter criteria

params.name: DateReference
params.description:
Specifies whether to filter by 'ArrivalDate' or 'EvaluationCompleteDate'. Defaults to 'ArrivalDate' if not specified.
Valid values: ArrivalDate, EvaluationCompleteDate

params.name: StartDate
params.description: The start date for filtering export receipts. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

params.name: EndDate
params.description: The end date for filtering export receipts. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. Must be equal to or later than StartDate.

params.name: Status
params.description: The status filter for calls. Valid values: 'Sampled', 'ReadyToSample', 'Processing', and 'FailedToProcess'.

params.name: LastId
params.description: GUID of the last result from the previous page. Used for cursor-based pagination.

params.name: HierarchyCodes
params.description: List of hierarchy codes to filter results. Can be provided as comma-separated string or multiple parameters.

items.docs:
Returns a list of receipts for interactions that have finished processing and match the specified criteria.
            
Each result in the response includes the following fields:
- ConversationId: Unique identifier for the conversation. Corresponds to the Id field from GET /Metadata and the ConversationId from GET /Conversations/Insights
- DateTimeReceived: The date/time the interaction arrived in the system
- ClientCallId: Your external telephony reference ID for this conversation
- DateTimeTr
